title: Expert Technical Analyst-Financial Messaging Team
description: Who we are? With offices in Kuwait City, Baku, Dubai, and Istanbul, we are providing services across 32 countries from Hong Kong to the UK. Since 2010, Fineksus has been recognized by the SWIFT Partner Management for its Service Delivery Centre in implementing, integrating, and upgrading services for SWIFT products and solutions. Since 2018, Fineksus has also been compliant with the Shared Infrastructure Programme required by SWIFT. In 2025, we joined the cleversoft group—a leading German software company—strengthening our presence in the global Fintech and RegTech space. We leverage machine learning and develop new financial crime detection techniques to ensure more efficient and effective AML compliance. Fineksus is the smart choice for financial institutions aiming to adapt to the ever-increasing demands of compliance in the financial industry. We are looking for an Expert Technical Analyst to join our R&D team . This hybrid role requires working 2 days per week in the office and reports to the Senior Manager of Test & Analysis . How will be your day like? Conduct end-to-end business and technical analysis for Financial Messaging projects Analyze business requirements and translate them into clear functional and technical specifications Act as a strong bridge between business units, customers, and technical teams (development, testing,etc.) Analyze and design integration scenarios using REST, SOAP, MQ, file-based and database-driven approaches Work on Financial Messaging modules such as message orchestration, archiving, reporting, and reconciliation Evaluate the impact of message, format, or integration changes across systems and product modules Identify potential risks early in the analysis phase and propose effective mitigation or solution alternatives Support test scenario creation and actively participate in UAT processes to ensure solution quality Contribute to continuous improvement of existing systems, analysis practices, and documentation standards Provide technical and analytical guidance to junior analysts when required Utilize AI-powered tools to improve efficiency and quality in analysis, documentation, and test preparation processes Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field Minimum 4 years of experience in business or technical analysis; preferably within finance, fintech, payment systems or banking Familiarity with analysis and modeling techniques such as UML, BPMN, use case, and sequence diagrams Strong documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear functional and technical requirement documents Ability to use AI-based tools effectively for requirement analysis, documentation, and test scenario generation Understanding of Financial Messaging concepts, including SWIFT MT and/or ISO 20022 (MX) message standards is preferred Experience with message orchestration, archiving, reporting, and reconciliation modules is a plus Familiarity with payment systems (EFT, RTGS, SEPA, FAST, etc.) Experience using AI/automation tools in analysis processes is a big advantage Experience with Web Service API integrations and database technologies (SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL) is preferred Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps is plus Understanding of testing and UAT processes is plus Proficiency in written and spoken English Supporting Skills Analytical Thinking: Analyzes complex problems and produces clear, structured solutions Comprehensive Approach : Evaluates system-wide impacts of changes across processes and integrations Communication: Communicates technical and business topics clearly to diverse stakeholders Agility: Adapts quickly to changing requirements and priorities Persuasion: Effectively influences stakeholders by clearly presenting analysis and solution options Proactivity: Anticipates risks early and takes initiative to address them Teamwork: Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams What’s in it for you? At Fineksus, we believe that work should enrich your life—not just fill your calendar. That’s why we offer a variety of benefits designed to support your well-being, growth, and happiness: Subsidized Meals: Enjoy subsidized meals to fuel your workday. Transportation Fee : We've got you covered, whether it's your daily commute or business travel. Healthcare Coverage : Your health matters. We provide comprehensive private health insurance plans. Communication Allowance: Stay connected with a dedicated mobile line. Recognition Rewards : Performance-based bonuses to acknowledge your contributions. Gift Card (Corporate) : Each year, we provide gift cards to our employees, allowing them to purchase their needs. Birthday Leave Flexibility : We celebrate you! Enjoy flexible time off around your birthday to make the most of your special day. Technical Training: Stay ahead with access to technical training programs designed to enhance your skills and knowledge. Special Occasion Gifts : Thoughtful surprises await you on special days—because we care about the moments that matter. Social Events : From happy hours and company picnics to year-end parties and special gatherings—we love creating memorable moments together. These events are our way of staying connected, having fun, and celebrating team spirit.

title: Backend ve Gömülü Yazılım Geliştirme Mühendisi
description: ASELSAN Ulaşım, Güvenlik, Enerji, Otomasyon ve Sağlık Sistemleri (UGES) Sektör Başkanlığı bünyesinde Macunköy yerleşkesindeki faaliyetlerimizde bize güç katacak; üniversitelerin Bilgisayar, Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun Backend ve Gömülü Yazılım Geliştirme Mühendisi çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. BU POZİSYONDA EN ÖNEM VERDİĞİMİZ YETKİNLİKLER VE DENEYİMLER Yazılım yaşam döngüsü evrelerine hakim, Geleneksel ve çevik geliştirme yöntemlerine aşina ve ekip içinde aktif katkı sunan, C/C++ programlama dillerini kullanarak backend/gömülü yazılım projelerinde görev almış olan, Tercihen Java ile backend servis geliştirme çalışmalarına aşina, Tercihen, gömülü Linux’da tecrübesi olan, Tercihen, gerçek zamanlı işletim sistemlerinde deneyimli, Tercihen, uç cihazlarda yapay zeka çıkarımı (Edge AI Inference / ONNX Runtime vb.) konusunda deneyimli, Tercihen, Linux ve Windows ortamlarında cross platform yazılım geliştirme tecrübesi olan, Tercihen, hata ayıklama ve profilleme araçlarını (GDB, Valgrind, perf, sanitizer'lar) etkin kullanabilen, Konfigürasyon yönetim sistemi (Git) ve sürüm kontrol süreçlerine hakim, Teknik dokümantasyon hazırlamaya ve güncel tutmaya yatkın, Görev kritik (Mission Critical) sistemlerde çalışma konusunda bilinçli ve disiplinli, Gerektiğinde seyahat ve sahada çalışmaya engeli bulunmayan. SENDEN NELER BEKLİYORUZ? Sensör projelerinde kullanılacak/kullanılan yazılımları tasarlamak, gerçeklemek ve idame ettirmek, Sistem mühendisliği, test, kalite vb. paydaşlar ile yakın iş birliği içinde sürdürülebilir ve güvenilir yazılım çözümleri üretmek, Projelerdeki C/C++ ve Java tabanlı backend ve gömülü yazılımları geliştirmek ve idame ettirmek, DevOps ve CI/CD hatlarıyla entegre test edilebilir ve sürdürülebilir yazılım geliştirmek. Yapılan tasarımların, kurumsal araçları kullanarak dokümantasyonunu hazırlamak/güncel tutmak, Kaynak kısıtlı donanımlarda performans ve bellek optimizasyonu yapmak, Gereksinim analizine katılmak ve yazılım mimarisi tasarımına katkı sağlamak, Kod gözden geçirme süreçlerinde aktif rol almak, birim ve entegrasyon testleri yazmak, Sistem entegrasyonu ve saha testlerinde görev almak, sahadan gelen hataları analiz etmek, Yeni teknolojileri araştırmak ve prototip geliştirmek. İşe alım kriterlerimizi ASELSAN internet sayfamızda Kariyer Sekmesinde bulunan İşe Alım Sürecimiz alanından inceleyerek iş başvuru formumuzu doldur. ASELSAN ailesinin bir parçası olarak yerli ve milli projelerdeki başarımızda senin de imzan olsun. Biz Kimiz? Alanında dünyanın en iyi ürünlerini yapma, oyun değiştirici teknolojiler geliştirme ve ihracat odaklı büyüme hedeflerimizle ülkemize ve dünyanın dört bir yanındaki kullanıcılarımıza değer katan küresel bir markayız.
